title: Benchmarking and Analyzing Generative Data for Visual Recognition

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating generative data quality and downstream visual recognition performance (via linear probing and the proposed CLER score) across 22 datasets divided into 'Common', 'Fine-grained', and 'Rare' concept categories. The paper measures the correlation between model performance and dataset-level mean text similarity (MTS) to show an inherent bias favoring categories that frequently occur in the generative model's pre-training dataset.
